text:
andrew: Heads-up — we're getting a p95 spike on POST /v1/rerank for a single high-volume customer (acme-retail). Symptoms: gateway 504s and 5xxs under sustained QPS ~600, lots of retries visible at the gateway.

hannah-sre: Confirmed. Gateway logs show repeated 504 (upstream timeout) and intermittent 502 from the serving tier. We also see increased tail latency on model nodes around the same window.

oliver-eng-runtime: Early hypothesis: very large candidate lists + default batching causing oversized GPU batches and KV cache pressure. Some nodes hit OOM/slow GC, which then return 502/524.

maya-support: Customer repro steps they provided: POST /v1/rerank with candidates ~220-250, include full context array. They say it becomes flaky after ~10m of steady traffic.

andrew: Repro curl they used (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_***" \
  -d '{"query":"...","candidates":[..., 250 items ...]}' \
  -H 'timeout: 30s'
```
Result -> 504 / gateway retry loop (client retries added to QPS).

ryan-eng-platform: Immediate mitigations we can push now: reduce batch_size default from 64 -> 16 for rerank route, enforce max_candidates per request = 100, and enable exponential backoff with jitter at the API gateway for 5xx/504. Also enable tenant-specific circuit breaker (trip on 5xx>5 in 1s).

support-ops-bot: Applied temporary routing change: affected customer traffic routed to fallback pool (lower model throughput but more stable) and we rolled an on-call rollback for their dedicated quantized variant v2q.

oliver-eng-runtime: Can you paste one of the X-Request-Id values for a failed request? Need proxy + worker logs to correlate. Sample lines I want: proxy start, worker receive, worker queue time, model start, model end.

andrew: Sample X-Request-Id: abc123-req. Proxy excerpt: 
```
[proxy] id=abc123 start=2025-11-04T14:21:03Z route=/v1/rerank
[proxy] id=abc123 upstream=10.4.8.22:504 start=+1200ms status=504
[worker] id=abc123 queued=980ms batch_size=192 process=2100ms mem=11.8GB
[model] id=abc123 kernel=attention_v2 exec=1850ms
```
This shows large queueing + very big batch.

hannah-sre: Also noticed a side issue: a small subset of requests returned 401 — customer was rotating keys and some workers still accepted old token due to cached auth. Separate but noted for support.

maya-support: CS flagged that billing saw a spike because retries multiplied token usage and tokens-per-call increased with larger candidate lists. Customer concerned about charges.

ryan-eng-platform: Short-term action list I committed:
- enforce max_candidates=100 at edge (no-inflight translation)
- set route default batch_size=16 and max_batch_delay=8ms
- tighten gateway retry policy: max_retries=2 with exponential jitter
- enable tenant circuit breaker and route fallback to lower-qps pool
I'll open an internal ticket and tag runtime/sre.

oliver-eng-runtime: Long-term suggestions: per-tenant candidate caching (embeddings cache), smarter batch packing that respects candidate count, backpressure from runtime to gateway, and instrument per-request batch_size in observability. Also add graceful degradation: if candidate_count > 120, automatically downsample top-K before rerank.

hannah-sre: We're going to also add synthetic load test for rerank with candidate arrays of 150/200 to reproduce in staging (avoids hitting prod customers). If we can reproduce, we'll try kernel tuning to reduce per-token latency spikes.

andrew: For the customer now we recommended: reduce candidates to <=100, rotate keys cleanly (fix 401), and accept temporary fallback pool while we stabilize. Customer accepted.

maya-support: CS requested an ETA for billing review for excess token usage from retries — assigned to finance ops.

ryan-eng-platform: I'll create the bug and link to request-id abc123 and the temporary config changes. Assigning to @oliver-eng-runtime and @hannah-sre for follow-up.

oliver-eng-runtime: Acknowledge. Will start with quick fix (cap candidates + reduce batch) and then a perf ticket for smarter packing.

hannah-sre: Thx. Will monitor p95 and 5xx rate over next 24h and revert routing if needed. :thumbsup:
